market_question: Will Thomas Massie be the Republican nominee for KY-04?
reasoning: Thomas Massie is the long-time incumbent with a very strong primary history, winning 82% of the vote in 2024 against an establishment-backed challenger. No serious opposition has arisen for 2026, and there is no indication he plans to retire. Barring a major scandal, his renomination probability is far above the market's 47.5%.
evidence_points: Massie won the 2024 KY-04 Republican primary with 82.3% of the vote.
No credible challenger has emerged for 2026; Massie has not announced retirement.
KY-04 is a deep-red district where incumbent Republicans rarely lose renomination.
sources_consulted: News coverage of 2024 KY-04 primary results
